zh: 上线 TestFlight 外部测试（G2）全自动挂载与审核提审流水线：iOS 云端上传完成后自动轮询等待苹果后台转码就绪，自动挂载至外部测试群组 G2，同步写入更新说明并自动触发 Beta 审核，通过后全自动推送至外部测试员，实现 100% 零人工干预闭环。
Open-AutoGLM 手机端自动化 API 密钥安全托管至平台保险箱（Vault）：彻底移除代码库与文档中的明文 Key，运行时由 Node 后端与 Python 客户端通过 AES-256-GCM 本地加密按需动态提取，敏感凭据绝不入库、绝不泄露至 AI 上下文，技能无需重新安装即可即时无感生效。
Dragon Claw 2.0 Web 基座与技能中心全面支持全员开放/未全员开放权限标识与严密右对齐排版：输入框 @ 技能联想浮层、侧栏「发现应用」搜索弹窗、+ 附加菜单及技能中心卡片均增加双色开放徽章与快捷分类筛选，右侧标签容器消除居中漂移与视觉错乱，超级管理员可全链路把控资产可见范围。
en: Introduce automated TestFlight G2 external distribution and review submission pipeline: automatically polls until Apple finishes processing, binds the build to external group G2, populates localized release notes, and submits for Beta App Review for 100% hands-free release.

Securely migrate Open-AutoGLM mobile automation API credentials into the platform Vault: all plaintext keys are stripped from codebase and documentation, resolved dynamically at runtime via AES-256-GCM encryption without leaking to LLM context, and skills operate seamlessly without manual refreshes.

Dragon Claw 2.0 Web base and Skill Hub now fully support shared access indicators with strict right-aligned badge columns: chat composer @ skill autocomplete, sidebar Discover Apps modal, plus menu, and Skill Hub cards all display shared/unshared badges and quick category filters for comprehensive distribution control.
